risk_reason: Multiple documents show strong generative / synthetic image signals; passport number on visa (Z1234567) does not match passport (Z78456231); photo-patch and AI-vision detectors flagged the ID portraits.
officer_checklist: Compare live person to all document photos
Confirm visa passport number matches passport Z78456231
Inspect physical documents for print quality and photo splice
Do not rely on Aadhaar QR alone

Live face matches document portraits within threshold (same synthetic subject).
Uploaded document images meet clarity threshold.

human_summary: AI-synthesis and photo-patch detectors flagged passport, visa, and Aadhaar images; visa passport number does not match the passport MRZ/number.
